# Basilica

Agent-facing Basilica cloud ops bundle for coding agents.

Install the local skills bundle:

```bash
basilica skills install
```

Primary resources:

- Full bundle: `https://basilica.ai/llms-full.txt`
- Cloud ops playbook: `https://basilica.ai/agents/cloud-ops.md`
- Repo agent guide: `https://basilica.ai/agents/AGENTS.md`
- Skills repo: `https://github.com/one-covenant/basilica-skills`

Skill files:

- `https://github.com/one-covenant/basilica-skills/tree/main/skills/use-basilica`
